name: aexus
description: Native Coding Agents, independent Roles, and cloud host workspaces

scripts.test:select: npm run build && node tests/build-styled-select.cjs && swiftc -parse-as-library tests/styled-select-webkit.swift -framework AppKit -framework WebKit -o artifacts/styled-select-webkit && artifacts/styled-select-webkit artifacts/styled-select-test.bundle.js tests/styled-select-webkit.js ui/style.css
scripts.test:native: npm run build && swiftc -parse-as-library tests/terminal-input-webkit.swift -framework AppKit -framework WebKit -o artifacts/terminal-input-check && artifacts/terminal-input-check dist/ui/terminal.bundle.js tests/terminal-input.js dist/ui/style.css
scripts.test:board-native: npm run build && node_modules/.bin/esbuild tests/board-native-entry.js --bundle --format=iife --target=es2022 --outfile=artifacts/board-native-entry.js && swiftc -parse-as-library tests/board-resize-webkit.swift -framework AppKit -framework WebKit -o artifacts/board-1to6-check && artifacts/board-1to6-check artifacts/board-native-entry.js tests/board-1to6-webkit.js dist/ui/style.css
scripts.test:rdp-native-ui: npm run build && node_modules/.bin/esbuild tests/native-rdp-ui-entry.js --bundle --format=iife --target=es2022 --outfile=artifacts/native-rdp-ui-entry.js && swiftc -parse-as-library tests/native-rdp-ui-webkit.swift -framework AppKit -framework WebKit -o artifacts/native-rdp-ui-check && artifacts/native-rdp-ui-check artifacts/native-rdp-ui-entry.js tests/native-rdp-ui-webkit.js dist/ui/style.css
